carrier.contract: Each arrow maps the argv of one watch to one terminal verdict of one PR, and the JSON line of that verdict keeps schemaVersion 1, mode single and the single READY scope. A status ask maps the plan, the board and the gh reads to one reply that lists each waiting item and changes nothing.

category.equality: Two verdicts are equal when their JSON lines are equal byte for byte. Two catch-up replies are equal when they list the same waiting items and the same failed reads.

abstraction.hides: The board query, the plan reads and the gh reads of a status ask, and the gh reads and the poll loop of one watch.
callersKnow: Each waiting item gets one line in a catch-up, and a failed read gets its own line.
A status ask only reads and starts no work.
A checkpoint names up to 3 waiting items, and past 3 gives their count and says that status lists them.
astack watch-pr watches one PR, and a removed stack flag exits 64 with no reader call.
The JSON lines of a watch keep schemaVersion 1, mode single and the single READY scope.
abstraction.deletionTest: Without the Catch up part, each status ask builds the waiting list from the plan, the board and gh in its own words, and the card resume row starts work.

omitted: Settle stands for an owner answer, a merge or a closed draft, which happen outside astack code.

The watch-pr cut, the names and the caps change no reply rule, so they have no model state. The wp-one-pr, wp-single-json, wp-text-commands, an-names and an-models-header controls and the budget gate examine them.
The model takes the reads of the plan, the board and gh as true observations.

bounds: 4 waiting items, so a reply over 3 items and a reply over 4 items are both reachable.
One reply at a time, after each raise or settle of an item.

negative.replacement: listed |-> IF Cardinality(waiting) > FoldAt THEN {} ELSE waiting,
negative.defect: A catch-up that folds 4 waiting items into a count, as the old checkpoint did with the open questions, hides each item from the owner.

limits: The finite model takes the reads of the plan, the board and gh as true observations. The cu-list and cu-checkpoint controls examine the texts.
The model does not check the watch-pr cut, the names or the caps. Their controls and the budget gate examine them.
The model does not check the words of the docs, the ADR and the plan. Review and the STE gates examine them.
Exact-head CI, review and every ordinary gate stay required.
